title: prefill: integrate chunked prefill + speculative prefill + prefill-decode stage overlap for improved tail latency
author: Anika Rao
description: Combine three complementary prefill/decoding optimizations into a single end-to-end pipeline change: 1) chunked prefill: split long prefill sequences into fixed-size chunks processed in parallel to reduce memory pressure and enable earlier KV materialization; 2) speculative prefill: kick off decoding work based on partially materialized KV state for prefixes that are unlikely to change, allowing overlap of prefill+decode for mixed latency-critical workloads; 3) prefill-decode stage overlap: a scheduler change to allow decode tokens to be produced while remaining prefill chunks are still being processed, with strict correctness checks for KV dependencies and fallbacks to conservative execution when conflicts are detected. Motivation: previous prefill pipeline serialized large prefill tensors and introduced tail latency spikes for long-context requests and mixed prefill/decode workloads. This change reduces tail p99 latency and improves throughput for both single-request and batch workloads while preserving deterministic outputs. Key design points: deterministic correctness guarantees via speculative tombstones and per-request validation; conservative fallback path on conflict or checksum mismatch; new scheduling heuristics that prioritize short decodes when they can be safely overlapped; kernel-level small-chunk optimized matmul path to lower per-chunk overhead; KV cache write coalescing and early-visible prefix caching to enable speculative decode to read consistent state. Included benchmarks: internal perf harness (perf-canary) shows 15-28% p50 improvement and 35-55% p99 reduction on long-context Llama-like models (8k-32k contexts) in single-GPU dedicated tests and 10-30% throughput uplift under mixed workloads on multi-GPU serving rigs. Backpressure and autoscaling compatibility: scheduler integrates with existing autoscale hooks and batching pipeline; experimental autotuner flags are behind feature gates. Checklist: done automated unit and integration tests, perf harness runs, manual verification on dedicated cluster, added docs and runtime flags, added feature gate default-off for private clusters. See linked Linear tickets ENG-1142 and ENG-1219 for rollout plan and canary steps.
commits: prefill: add chunked prefill executor and chunk metadata
runtime: implement speculative prefill controller and tombstone tracking
scheduler: allow prefill-decode overlap with conflict detection and fallback
kernels: add small-chunk GEMM fast-path and kernel selection heuristics
kv: early-visible prefix caching and coalesced writes
tests: add end-to-end prefill/decoding correctness tests and perf scenarios
docs: runtime flags and rollout guide for chunked/speculative prefill
discussion: Reviewer Liam Chen: Overall LGTM, left a few nits around locking in the chunk executor and a question about memory accounting. Author (Anika): addressed memory accounting by moving chunk buffers to arena allocator and added additional benchmarks; replied to locking question with explanation and added comment in code. Reviewer Sofia Martinez: requested a defensive checksum to detect KV divergence during speculative reads; author added per-chunk checksum and a deterministic rejoin path on mismatch. Reviewer Raj Patel: asked about interaction with autoscaler and batching; author added hooks to expose in-flight chunk metrics and a feature-gated autoscaler integration. CI: initial CI showed a flake in nightly integration tests (timing-dependent), fixed by adding deterministic sleep in test harness and re-running; final CI passed. Approvals: Liam Chen approved, Sofia approved after checksum changes, Raj approved. Merge method: squash and merge into main with canary rollout to dedicated clusters.
release_notes: Performance: Chunked+Speculative Prefill with Stage Overlap reduces p99 tail latency for long-context requests and increases throughput for mixed prefill/decode workloads. Notes: Feature disabled by default on private clusters; rollout plan in ENG-1142.
